messages:
arun: quick async check — routes & rlimits
arun: did: finished ratepolicy v2 PR and kicked off a 10% canary on staging
arun: blocker: started to see 429 spikes hitting /v1/embeds when burst >2000r/s, not sure if token-bucket or proxy queueing is the root cause
arun: today: dig into kv-cache + ingress queueing, attach logs to PR; rollback plan ready if we need it
jenn: did: landed jwt rotation fix and ran routing smoke tests against staging — no regressions on routing rules
jenn: blocker: need a reviewer for PR #4123 (gateway: ratepolicy v2) — pinging @mike
jenn: today: reproduce arun's 429 locally and check if ratepolicy interacts badly with our prefix cache
mike: will review PR today, noted. i've seen a similar 429 when batch_size briefly spiked in the pool
mike: quick suggestion: try lowering `max_inflight` in pool config from 128 -> 64 for the canary to see if it smooths bursts
arun: sample config I used for the canary:
```json
{"rate_limit": {"burst": 2000, "steady": 1500}, "pool": {"max_inflight": 128}}
```
chao: Incident bot created INC-2026-0342 for /v1/embeds 429 spike — assigned to eng-platform
olivia: did: reviewed routing dependencies, no policy changes in last deploy; noticed p95 latency climb on a subset of edge nodes
olivia: blocker: I don't have perf role on staging to pull spans, can someone grant access?
arun: @olivia added you to `perf-role` in staging just now, confirm if you can access traces
olivia: confirmed, can see traces now, looking for correlated spikes at ingress->runtime boundary
jenn: small ops request: please don't rollback between 10:00-14:00 PST if possible — customer demo at 13:00
mike: ack, we'll avoid a disruptive rollback during that window; if we need to mitigate we'll prefer a targeted traffic shift or throttle change
arun: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 — i'll attach the canary logs and a short replay script
mike: smoke test command for reproducing locally: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://staging.api.redwood/v1/embeds -d @batch.json` and watch for 429s in the 1m window
arun: will attach `batch.json` and logs to the PR, will keep canary at 10% for 1h and then reassess\jenn: thx — tagging @sre-team to monitor from your side during the canary :thumbsup:
sre-team: watching the canary, will page if error rate > 1% or if latency/p95 > 750ms
arun: followups: i'll open an issue for a deeper perf regression investigation if we see the pattern on more than one node\jenn: thanks — i'll queue the PR review and try to reproduce the 429 before lunch\mike: added a small note in the PR about reducing inflight for canary testing\olivia: sharing an initial trace snippet in the PR comments, looks like queuing happens right before runtime decode step
arun: good find, i'll correlate with pool metrics and KV cache hit rates\jenn: quick ops FYI: if we do rollback later please coordinate on #deploys so support knows about potential customer impact
arun: will update thread with results at ~1768910450
